projects.title: AI-Based Supply Chain Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
projects.description:
Developed a machine learning-based demand forecasting model using Python, SQL, and Power BI to analyze historical sales and inventory data, improving forecast accuracy by 15%.
Built an interactive dashboard to monitor key supply chain KPIs, including inventory turnover, fill rate, stock availability, and supplier performance, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Applied ABC Analysis, EOQ, and safety stock optimization techniques to recommend inventory replenishment strategies, reducing projected stockouts and excess inventory.

projects.title: specsage
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented question answering over a pinned corpus of IETF RFCs: documents are fetched, chunked, embedded, and indexed into Qdrant, then served through an API and web UI. Ships with an evaluation harness that scores both retrieval and generation quality, so answer accuracy is measured rather than assumed.

projects.title: advanced-rag-llm-app
projects.description: Advanced RAG application with LLM API integrations, inline citations, and a built-in evaluation flow. FastAPI backend with Pydantic-validated endpoints and support for PDF and text document ingestion.

projects.title: contextforge
projects.description: Self-hostable documentation answer bot that responds with answers grounded in and citing your own docs (Markdown, PDFs, or URLs) — and explicitly abstains when retrieval confidence is too low to trust an answer. Ships as an embeddable one-script-tag widget, a chat demo page, and an admin queue that turns every unanswered question into a prioritized docs backlog.

projects.title: sentinel-triage
projects.description: SOC alert-triage pipeline: endpoint and auth events stream through Redis into OpenSearch, get correlated into candidate incidents, and are matched against Sigma rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK before an LLM summarizes each incident citing the exact log lines it used. An eval harness reports precision, recall, and false-positive rate against a labeled dataset.

projects.title: mlops-app
projects.description: End-to-end MLOps pipeline on Google Cloud: Terraform-provisioned infrastructure, Prefect-orchestrated data flows, dbt transformations in BigQuery, MLflow experiment tracking, and a Dockerized FastAPI model API deployed to Cloud Run through GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.title: agentops-sentinel
projects.description: Supervisor/critique agent framework for support-ticket triage: a planner routes each ticket to specialized tool-using sub-agents, a self-critique loop accepts, retries, or escalates every result, and each decision is captured as an OpenTelemetry span in a decision-trace dashboard. Hard guardrails — step limits, a cost budget, and per-step timeouts — keep every run bounded even when tools fail.

projects.title: driftguard
projects.description: Closed-loop ML lifecycle demonstrated on real bike-share data: train, track and register in MLflow, serve via FastAPI, detect concept drift from prediction PSI, and auto-retrain — cutting held-out MAE by 44.6% after a real 2011-to-2012 demand shift. Evaluation is leakage-free: both model versions are scored only on a held-out slice neither was trained on.

projects.title: driftguard-llm
projects.description: RAG service with a monitoring plane built into its hot path: every query embedding feeds a statistical drift detector, while an LLM-as-judge harness scores a rolling sample of production responses for faithfulness and relevance — firing alerts and flagging stale documents for re-embedding when either signal degrades.

projects.title: modelcard
projects.description: Command-line tool that generates a deterministic Markdown model card from a trained scikit-learn estimator, its evaluation metrics, and dataset metadata — making reproducible, review-ready model documentation part of the workflow. Built with strict typing and a full test suite.
